greeting: Union Organizer Steel on comms. Stage 1: The Smog-Choked Sky. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Gears of Industry. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I put fear on a schedule. It keeps missing meetings.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Enter the Industrial Zone.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Enter the Industrial Zone; Witness worker conditions; Meet with Steel's network. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Enter Obsidian and witness the industrial exploitation. Immediate move: Enter the Industrial Zone.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 1 resolved: The Smog-Choked Sky. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Factory of Souls.
rumor: Shift bells ring a sixth time on nights with heavy seam activity.
People keep repeating one clue from The Smog-Choked Sky: 'Meet with Steel's network'.
If your shadow starts giving tactical advice, charge it rent and keep walking.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn shift change in Obsidian is your cleanest infiltration window.
dialog.time_noon: Noon overloads lines and tempers alike. Expect mechanical failures.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk smog reduces range. Move by waypoint, not by horizon.
dialog.time_night: Night whistles from broken pipes mimic voices. Confirm identities before opening doors.

party_reactions.kade: Union Organizer Steel sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Union Organizer Steel accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Union Organizer Steel talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: No speeches. Give me actionable details.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You made it back. Report status.
relationship_dialog.friend: With you here, the odds stop looking stupid.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Same plan as always: adapt, push, survive, repeat.
